items.title: Block duplicate component/hook/utility creation
items.description: Blocks (exit 2) creating a new file under components/|lib/hooks/|lib/utilities/|lib/actions/|src/components/|src/hooks/ when a similarly-named entry already exists in the project's COMPONENT_REGISTRY.md. No-op if the registry file doesn't exist.

items.title: Warn on related files missing from a commit
items.description: On `git commit` commands, warns (stderr, never blocks) when a staged component's matching hook file references it but isn't also staged, or when collection/model/schema files are staged without a corresponding types file.

items.title: Session-start sprint/registry freshness banner
items.description: Prints project name, staleness of CURRENT_SPRINT.md/COMPONENT_REGISTRY.md (warns if >24h old), the active sprint item, and an uncommitted-file count. Heavier than the plugin's default lightweight banner in hooks.json.

items.title: Suggest a skill based on prompt keywords
items.description: Detects implementation/bugfix/refactor/completion/context-fatigue/performance keywords in the user's prompt and suggests a matching skill via systemMessage before Claude proceeds. Fixed 2026-08-04: was reading a nonexistent "user_prompt" JSON field (actual field is "prompt"), so it never fired.

items.title: Flag mutation/cache keywords in prompts
items.description: When the prompt combines a mutation/cache keyword (stale cache, revalidate, useMutation, afterChange, ...) with a bug/error keyword, suggests `@analyze-mutations` / `@check-mutation` before proceeding. Lets explicit @-triggers and /rhize-devflow:mutation through unconditionally.

items.title: Warn on incomplete mutation patterns before write
items.description: On .ts/.tsx files under actions/api/hooks/mutations/collections/payload (or mutation-shaped filenames), warns when Supabase mutations lack error handling/revalidateTag/revalidatePath, useMutation calls lack onError/onSettled/query-key factories, or Payload CollectionConfig lacks afterChange/afterDelete. Fixed 2026-08-04: field extraction used GNU-only `grep -oP`, which macOS's default BSD grep rejects outright, so the hook silently never matched.

items.title: Detect Sentry/stale-data investigation prompts
items.description: When the prompt contains a sentry.io issue URL, or investigation + data/cache/mutation keywords, or explicit stale-data phrasing, prints a data-mutation-consistency investigation checklist. Fixed 2026-08-04: previously read the prompt from a positional $1 argument Claude Code never populates (it delivers UserPromptSubmit payloads as JSON on stdin); now reads and parses stdin.

items.title: Block edits to CI/env/billing files and leaked secrets
items.description: Blocks (exit 2) edits to .github/workflows/*, .env*, and billing/payment paths; also content-gates NEXT_PUBLIC_* secret-named vars and Supabase service-role references written into 'use client' files. Local per-plugin copy of the same gate as the global ~/.claude/hooks/protect-files.sh (that one already runs for every session regardless of this manifest; wire this one in only if you want the gate active even in environments without the global hook installed).

items.title: Detect skill-refinement opportunities in prompts
items.description: Detects phrasing like "skill doesn't work", "missing trigger", "false positive" and suggests running `npx @rhize/skill-forge refine` to capture the gap.

items.title: Prompt for refinements after a substantial session
items.description: At session end, computes tool-call count, tool-error count, distinct files written, and session duration from the transcript JSONL; if any threshold is exceeded (>20 tool calls, any error, >60min, >10 files), suggests `npx @rhize/skill-forge refine`. Fixed 2026-08-04: previously read SESSION_TOOL_CALLS/SESSION_ERRORS/SESSION_DURATION/SESSION_FILES_TOUCHED from the environment, which Claude Code never sets (it delivers only session_id/transcript_path/cwd on stdin), so the hook never fired; now derives the same stats from the transcript file.
